call.title: Research — why people stop using the meal-plan app
call.content:
Research — why people stop using the meal-plan app

## Findings
- Planning takes too long on weekdays — 3 of 3 participants. P1: "By Wednesday I just give up and order pizza." P2: "Sunday is the only day I have time to plan."
- The shopping list is the part they value — 2 of 3. P2: "Honestly I only open it for the list."

## Interview guide
Warm-up: tell me about how meals get decided in your home.
1. Tell me about the last week you used the app. — What happened on the day you stopped?
2. Walk me through making this week's shopping list. — What did you do by hand?
Avoid asking: "Would you use a faster planner?" (hypothetical); "Don't you think the list is useful?" (leading).

## Open questions
- one participant: sharing meals with a flatmate (P3) — worth asking the next participants

script.say:
3 participants, 2 themes.

## Report
- read 3 transcripts; wrote "Research — why people stop using the meal-plan app"
